note: 用户 2026-10-02 第二次试听：普通战斗定为“仅交叉淡化拼接”。旧渡首领战选重画种子 11，其余部分不动，只改两处：① 0:03–0:09 的乐器音色不好，由它衍生的 0:29–0:35 也一样，用 XL 加噪重渲染换音色质感（保留音符与节奏），两段取自同一次渲染；② 0:48 进入的旋律收得太急、戛然而止，参照种子 44 在 0:36–0:48 的留白处理，重画时让乐句早收、留出呼吸。整句重画与只重画后半句各出一组。

edits.title: 首领战 · 0:03–0:09 与 0:29–0:35 换音色
edits.caption: Instrumental Chinese martial arts (wuxia) boss battle music for a video game, high-fidelity studio recording. Driving Chinese war drums, tense pipa tremolo and rapid strumming, a staccato string ostinato and short low brass accents, erhu and dizi with rich, warm, natural acoustic timbre. Tense and thrilling, constant forward momentum. No vocals, no electric guitar, no synthesizer.

edits.title: 首领战 · 0:48 进入的乐句留白（整句重画）
edits.caption: Instrumental Chinese martial arts (wuxia) boss battle music for a video game. The erhu and dizi phrase that enters here is short and resolves early on a long sustained note, then leaves breathing space: the texture thins out to sparse drums and a held low string drone before the next section. Unhurried phrase ending, no abrupt cut-off. No vocals, no electric guitar, no synthesizer.
